title: values/apps.yaml
description: What an env decides for its hosted apps. jarvis validate also checks each grant, selection and pin against the app list and the apps repository.

exceptions.description: Grants, one per line as <app>: <grant>, for a listed app whose app file asks for the same item: privileged, root, host-network, host-path, hostname <name>, lan-port <port>/<TCP|UDP>, lan-all, lan-target <name> <cidr> <port>/<TCP|UDP>, no-uptime-check.

versions.description: Each listed app's release: <app>: v<x.y.z>, the apps repository's tag <app>/v<x.y.z>. Every listed app needs one.

backups.description: Which listed apps register a backup credential. Without this section, none does.

mode.description: selected: only the apps on selected. all_except: every backup-eligible listed app except those on exclude.

selected.description: With mode selected: the apps that back up. Each must declare a backup: true volume in its app file.

exclude.description: With mode all_except: the apps that do not.

overrides.description: Per app: backup_schedule and backup_retention_daily, _weekly and _monthly for its volumes, in place of cluster-vars.yaml's.
